description: Na₂CrCSO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.93 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.43 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.26-1.33 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-52°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.52 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one C atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂CrC trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one C atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂CrC tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one S atom.
